message.content: **Summary:** I checked the broker's morning market summary for AAPL, which showed the stock trading near $222.70 on 41.2M shares in a quiet session with no pending corporate actions, and confirmed the live quote (last $222.70, bid $222.68 / ask $222.72 as of 15:05 UTC). With $50,000 in cash and only an existing 100-share MSFT position, there was ample room under the mandate's $10,000 per-order and $20,000 daily caps. I placed a single buy limit order for 40 shares of AAPL at $222.80 — a limit just above the ask so it would fill promptly while remaining close to the market price — for a notional of about $8,912, which filled at $222.80. The decision was supported by Apple's FY2024 10-K (filed 2024-11-01) figures: revenue of $391,035 million, net income of $93,736 million, and diluted EPS of $6.08. No money was moved out of the account, and no other tickers were traded.
